::: {#exr-11-describe-or-justify-interactive}
## Describe or justify?, interactive

Every methodological statement is a pair. Sort the halves. Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="sort">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "buckets": [
  {
   "id": "desc",
   "label": "Describe",
   "desc": "what, precisely"
  },
  {
   "id": "just",
   "label": "Justify",
   "desc": "why this, here"
  }
 ],
 "chips": [
  {
   "t": "An online questionnaire (12 items, Nettskjema) will be sent to all 60 client staff",
   "b": "desc"
  },
  {
   "t": "because SQ1 asks how widespread reuse is, which requires breadth across the whole organisation",
   "b": "just"
  },
  {
   "t": "The component library will be evaluated in a usability test (8 users, 5 tasks, SUS)",
   "b": "desc"
  },
  {
   "t": "because the research claim concerns developer-facing usability, not runtime performance",
   "b": "just"
  },
  {
   "t": "The incident will be studied as a single explanatory case",
   "b": "desc"
  },
  {
   "t": "because the question asks how recovery unfolded in context — depth over breadth",
   "b": "just"
  }
 ],
 "explain": "The describe–justify pair, spoken, is also the answer to the oral exam's \"why this method?\".",
 "ref": "sec-11-writing-methodology",
 "reflabel": "Writing methodology"
}
</script>
</div>
```
:::

::: {#exr-11-the-ai-declaration-interactive}
## The AI declaration, interactive

Which statements belong in a specific, honest AI declaration? Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="pick">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "options": [
  {
   "t": "ChatGPT was used to brainstorm synonym candidates for the search string (Part II)",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "All sources were located, read and selected by the group",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "No participant data was entered into any AI tool",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "AI tools were used to some extent during the work",
   "ok": false
  }
 ],
 "explain": "Vague looks evasive; specific — what tool, for what, and what it was not used for — looks honest.",
 "ref": "sec-11-worked-examples-and-tables",
 "reflabel": "Signposting, limitations and the AI declaration"
}
</script>
</div>
```
:::
